# Build your own robot vacuum, robot mop, or vacuum-mop combo

> DIY robot vacuum, robot mop and robot vacuum-mop combo: source-available hardware (FSL-1.1-MIT) with laser-cut and 3D-printed parts, ESP32 firmware, a coverage path planner, and a cleaning simulator you can try in your browser on your own room.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
